comment: Pinned downloads of the Java oracle (tools/oracle/fetch.ps1). Everything is downloaded at run time into %LOCALAPPDATA%\gf-oracle (or $env:GF_ORACLE_HOME) and verified by SHA-256; nothing here is ever committed. The TF jar is only loaded by the server: no file is ever extracted from it (rules R10, R11).

twilightforest.provenance: 4.8.3802 is the last 1.21.1-branch CI build (TF's azure-pipelines.yml publishes <mod_version>.<revision> to maven.tamaized.com, group team-twilight; neo_version 21.1.209 as in TF's gradle.properties). Verified once when pinned: all 1566 .java files of twilightforest-4.8.3802-sources.jar are byte-identical to src/main/java of the pinned commit; the commits after the last code change touch only build files and one .nbt template.
